rationales.explanation: Elizabeth expressed enthusiasm about trying the product and described the experience as immersive, fascinating, cute, and as feeling like being present in the room.
Elizabeth noted that the demonstrated experience was somewhat grainy.
Elizabeth asked how the demonstrated video was captured, probing the product's technical operation.
Elizabeth asked whether advances in AI could improve the demonstrated graininess over time.
Elizabeth asked about the envisioned business model.
Elizabeth observed that the Apple headset's high price point would limit initial sales and that VR headset adoption had been disappointing.
Elizabeth worried that Wist is dependent on people owning headsets and is therefore beholden to the headset market.
Elizabeth requested the financing terms for the round.
Elizabeth asked how much of the round was already accounted for, probing fundraising progress.
Elizabeth asked about the current team composition beyond the two cofounders.
Elizabeth asked when the business was started, probing the founders' operating history.
Although Elizabeth invested $50k, she explicitly said the founders should have an answer about what the 71 signed-up people are doing, indicating insufficient visibility into actual product usage.
